Thanks again for the demo last week — the model performance looks very promising. Quick ask: can Redwood provision additional trial/promotional credits (or a short-term top-up) so we can run the full pass? Our estimate is ~150,000 tokens to complete the scenarios. If possible, we'd like the credits in place by early Tuesday to do a dry run.

I'll attach the test plan and expected traffic profile (edge-poc-initial-specs.pdf). We're under a short timeline for the internal SRE sign-off, so any speed here helps.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
